V-M-PORTABLE-EXPORT.Scenario: Export preserves source files and visible content, uses explicit file and anchor destinations, is repeatable and refuses to overwrite an unowned folder. The relocated package opens every page under file URLs and supports both-language search, language switches, theme carry-over, embedded fonts, diagram zoom and manual copying without external resource requests. Each section bundles its own search index; the neighbour browser check exercises cross-section navigation and Discovery search in a disposable export.

A local Chromium pass does not establish corporate Windows SMB access, browser policy or file associations. External references still need their usual access. The export only contains the last generated website state.
V-M-PORTABLE-EXPORT.TraceAssertion: Commands exit zero. The browser report records the package manifest hash and direct-file evidence in .runtime/portable/browser-report.json.

V-M-PORTAL-NEIGHBOURS.Scenario: Portfolio fixtures protect shared ordinary capacity, Waiting context and retained capacity, off-flow exits, standing exclusions, recorded order and unknown dates/measures. Current-record checks compare all ten identities, board/register/search destinations, milestone projection and role-safe fields. Source disagreements and changed WIP limits are tested. Browser checks cover every summary and register/workflow route in EN/RU at four widths and two themes, priority/text filters, empty results, keyboard tabs, dialog dismissal/focus return, search, counterpart routes, contrast, no-script reading and disposable direct-file output. The generated site exposes five navigation groups, section-local search and body links, equivalent language routes and separate statuses. Discovery retains every source page, scenario and context statement with unchanged source text and identifiers; the additional Regulatory Horizon pages retain their authored links and scenario marks. Shared card layouts cover overview, domain, detail and workflow pages without clipping. Chromium covers every neighbour page at desktop and mobile widths in both themes, keyboard-operated scenario disclosures, tabs, source stage dialogs, overview and domain stage links, keyboard focus, section switching, language counterparts and search fragments. AI Lab retains all source blocks, task/lane assignments and supplied coverage values, with identical unit keys in Russian and fail-closed translation freshness. Lab browser checks cover every stage/lane combination, reset, task search, fragment reveal, sidebar anchors, shared feedback, both themes, four viewport widths, scripting-disabled reading and direct-file controls. The service-resolution project retains all twelve source bodies, 64 tables and seven diagrams per edition, with independently compared text atoms and graph geometry. Browser checks cover every document and diagram in both languages/themes at desktop and mobile widths, smaller/intermediate views, section and intra-project references, search, counterpart routes, native modal zoom/fit/actual-size/pan/close/focus behavior, no-script reading and portable output. Existing AICC search, diagram zoom and template copying remain functional. A disposable file package resolves all pages and supports section-scoped search and navigation.

Portfolio checks do not authorize business cases or decisions, confirm achieved benefits or provide shared editing. Registry remains the maintained operational and evidence source. These checks do not validate the banking assumptions or illustrative measures in the retained Discovery material, establish project approval, validate AI Lab as approved Bank policy or its illustrative scorecard as measured readiness, or prove corporate SMB browser policy. Do not run the browser sweep while rebuilding the generated output.
V-M-PORTAL-NEIGHBOURS.TraceAssertion: All commands exit zero. Browser evidence is recorded in .runtime/portfolio/browser-report.json, .runtime/portal-neighbours/browser-report.json, .runtime/ai-lab/browser-report.json and .runtime/project/browser-report.json. The full-site link and repeat-build checks remain owned by V-M-PORTAL-SOURCE and V-M-PORTAL-PROJECTION.

V-M-PORTAL-SOURCE.Scenario: Pinned English source hashes match the language layout, reviewed translations match their source identities and revisions, both route sets and assets resolve, and rebuilding the static site is repeatable.
Passing does not prove translated content exists or that the pages look right in a browser. Missing content translations are warnings only.
V-M-PORTAL-SOURCE.TraceAssertion: The command must exit 0. Its evidence covers the source and the projection consistency, not browser behaviour.

V-M-PORTAL-PROJECTION.Scenario: Both language route sets have resolved internal links, anchors and assets. The actual renderer selects reviewed Russian text, source identity, search and diagrams, and renders missing translations as marked English.
Static checks and renderer fixtures do not prove screen-reader behavior, visual layout, or complete translation. The older first-slice browser script is not a current whole-site acceptance gate.
V-M-PORTAL-PROJECTION.TraceAssertion: Both commands exit zero. The page count, source-language attributes, counterpart links, and repeated build output are observable evidence.

V-M-AICC-DEPLOY.Scenario: Unit tests and integration tests pass: hashing vectors, folder diff, manifest, HTTP client, safety refusals, dry run writes nothing, publish mirrors and removes stale files and pushes origin then websvc, a second run does nothing, and verification compares the served manifest.

Passing does not prove the real server hook, Caddy, or Cloudflare path works. Integration tests use temporary repositories and local bare remotes, and never touch the real deploy repository. The first real publish is verified by the tool's own served-manifest check.
V-M-AICC-DEPLOY.TraceAssertion: Both commands must pass. Evidence covers the deploy tool only, not the portal build, which is verified by V-M-PORTAL-SOURCE.

V-M-PORTAL-LOCALIZATION.Scenario: Reviewed Russian source renders with its own language and translated identifier while retaining canonical record identity. Draft/missing translations keep English text and identity. Localized tables use stable canonical lookup keys.
Stale hashes, wrong document identifiers, changed numbered clauses, table-shape drift, changed record dates, and orphan translations are rejected.
V-M-PORTAL-LOCALIZATION.TraceAssertion: Tests and source checks exit zero. Human review still establishes semantic equivalence and professional terminology.
